Hi Sara / Brian —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a recommended next step so we can get your infra team hands-on:

- Key risks you raised: token retention for reranking, cross-account KV caching, and SOC2 evidence for request logs.
- Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical deep dive (ML + infra + security) where our SEs will: walk runtime decisions, run a short live perf demo (10–15 min), and map integration points.

Proposed windows (US/Eastern):
- Wed 2026-12-29: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30

Please confirm which slot(s) work and who from your side will attend (title + role). I attached a one-page proposed agenda and an availability poll CSV to make it easy.

Also: are there any compliance pre-reads your security team would like from us before the session? We can share a short package.

Thanks — I’ll hold these slots tentatively until I hear back.

Best,
